description: This Java source file defines the PayPalServices class, which provides methods for integrating with PayPal's NVP API. It handles operations such as setting up express checkout, retrieving checkout details, completing transactions, authorizations, captures, voids, and refunds. The class manages the communication with PayPal, processes responses, and updates the shopping cart and order data accordingly.

classes.name: PayPalServices.TokenWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class for PayPal checkout tokens, used as a key in the token-cart map with proper equals and hashCode implementations.

methods.name: setExpressCheckout
methods.description: Initiates a PayPal express checkout by creating a payment request, communicating with PayPal, and storing the checkout token along with a weak reference to the shopping cart.

methods.name: payPalCheckoutUpdate
methods.description: Handles the return from PayPal after the user approved payment, updating the shopping cart with billing and shipping information, estimated shipping costs, and creating PayPal payment methods.

methods.name: getExpressCheckout
methods.description: Retrieves details from PayPal's GetExpressCheckoutDetails API, associates user info and contact mechanisms with the order, and updates the cart accordingly.

methods.name: doExpressCheckout
methods.description: Completes the Express Checkout payment by calling DoExpressCheckoutPayment API and updating the payment method with transaction details, with retry logic for transient errors.

methods.name: doAuthorization
methods.description: Performs a PayPal authorization (authorization hold) for an order to capture funds later.

methods.name: doCapture
methods.description: Captures a previously authorized PayPal transaction to finalize the payment.

methods.name: doVoid
methods.description: Voids a PayPal authorization or order, effectively canceling the transaction.

methods.name: doRefund
methods.description: Issues a refund for a captured PayPal transaction, either full or partial.

methods.name: getPaymentMethodGatewayPayPal
methods.description: Retrieves the payment gateway configuration for PayPal based on store settings and service type.

methods.name: sendNVPRequest
methods.description: Sends an NVP API request to PayPal and returns the decoded response.

methods.name: getCountryGeoIdFromGeoCode
methods.description: Finds the internal geo ID for a country given its ISO code.

methods.name: parseStateProvinceGeoId
methods.description: Resolves the geo ID for a state or province based on PayPal's return data, matching it to entity records.
